input: Track my net worth monthly in a spreadsheet

gold.taskTitle: Track Net Worth Monthly in a Spreadsheet
gold.taskDescription: Set up and maintain a monthly spreadsheet system to track personal net worth over time.

questions.title: Which spreadsheet tool do you plan to use?
questions.description: Identify the platform the user wants to build this in, such as Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, or another tool.

questions.title: What asset types do you currently own?
questions.description: Understand which assets need to be tracked, such as cash, investments, retirement accounts, real estate, or vehicles.

questions.title: What liabilities do you want to include?
questions.description: Clarify which debts should be tracked, such as mortgage, student loans, car loans, or credit card balances.

questions.title: Do you want automatic data pulls or manual entry?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants to link accounts for live data or enter figures manually each month.

questions.title: What specific date each month will you update it?
questions.description: Pin down a recurring update schedule so reminders and habits can be built around a consistent date.

questions.title: Do you want charts or graphs to visualize trends?
questions.description: Find out if the user wants visual summaries such as a net worth growth line chart alongside the raw numbers.

questions.title: Are you starting from scratch or have existing data?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has past net worth figures they want to import or if this is a brand new baseline.
